from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
from numpy import *

T = array([int] * 20)


def Saisie():
    global N
    b = False
    while not b:
        N = int(input("Donner n: "))
        b = 5 <= N <= 20
    return N


def Remplir(N):
    for i in range(N):
        b = False
        while not b:
            T[i] = int(input("T[" + str(i) + "]="))
            b = len(str(T[i])) == 4


def Appartenance(s, T, N):
    p = int(s)
    ok1 = False
    i = -1
    while not (ok1) and i < N - 1:
        i += 1
        ok1 = T[i] == p
    ok2 = False
    j = -1
    while not (ok2) and j <= N - 1:
        j += 1
        ok2 = (str(p))[:3] == (str(T[j]))[:3]

    if ok1:
        f.t2.setText("p appartient totalement à T")
    elif ok2:
        f.t2.setText("p appartient partiellement à T")
    else:
        f.t2.setText("p n'appartient pas à T")


##############""pp############
N = Saisie()
Remplir(N)
app = QApplication([])
f = loadUi('bac_pratique_2012_sujet1_interface.ui')
f.show()
f.pb.clicked.connect(lambda: Appartenance(f.t1.text(), T, N))
app.exec_()
